explanation: It is non-zero only at D1, and only when the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded; at GO and D2, and at D1 after no reward or after a reward from S2, it is 0. It builds over a run of consecutive rewarded S1 trials, usually choosing a1: about 0-3 at the first such D1 after a switch or loss, 5-8 at the second, and 9-10 from the third on, mainly in mid-to-late episode (trials 40-70), while runs before trial 30 stay at 0-2.
